title: Saint Catherine of Siena, Virgin and Doctor of the Church
short_summary: Saint Catherine of Siena is honored in the Dominican calendar as a virgin and Doctor of the Church whose prayer, charity, counsel, and love for Church unity flowed from union with Christ.
key_facts: The Dominican Calendarium keeps Saint Catherine of Siena as a feast on April 29.
The Order of Preachers identifies her as a virgin and Doctor of the Church.
The Order's saints and blesseds page says she was born in Siena in the Fontebranda district.
Benedict XVI connected her teaching with her recognition as a Doctor of the Church.
Her Dominican observance remains local or proper in the app and does not replace the general U.S. calendar day.

sections.heading: Prayer at the center
sections.body: Catherine's public witness cannot be separated from prayer. Her counsel and courage flowed from a life turned toward Christ, not from mere force of personality.

sections.heading: Charity and reform
sections.body: Her love for the Church included a desire for holiness and reform. She could speak with urgency because her concern was the good of souls and the unity of the Church.

sections.heading: Doctor of the Church
sections.body: Catherine's title as Doctor of the Church recognizes teaching that nourishes the whole Church. Her voice joins contemplation, doctrine, and practical charity.

sections.heading: A Dominican feast
sections.body: The app displays this feast as part of the Dominican proper calendar for users who choose that preference. It remains distinct from the primary general U.S. calendar day.

catholic_connection_sections.heading: Love for Christ and the Church
catholic_connection_sections.body: Catherine's witness holds together personal holiness and love for the visible Church, never treating them as rivals.

catholic_connection_sections.heading: Truth spoken in charity
catholic_connection_sections.body: Her example shows that Catholic reform is not contempt for the Church, but a call to deeper fidelity, humility, and conversion.

catholic_connection_sections.heading: Contemplation bearing fruit
catholic_connection_sections.body: Catherine shows that deep prayer can become service, counsel, and courage when it remains rooted in Christ.
